fund.title: A sponsor funds a pool
fund.description: Match rate, cap and vesting lock at launch.

deposit.title: You deposit SPYx
deposit.description: Your share of the match is reserved in the same transaction.

vest.title: The match vests
vest.description: In a straight line. Claim or leave anytime.

outcomes.title: Leave anytime. Keep what's vested.
outcomes.caption: Illustrative: 100 SPYx deposit, 1:1 match, 12-month vesting.
outcomes.ariaRow: Month {month}: your {deposit} SPYx deposit comes back, you keep {kept} SPYx of the match, and {returned} SPYx goes back to the sponsor.

deposit.title: Your deposit comes back whole.
deposit.body: Leaving early only costs the match that hasn't vested.

rules.title: Rules lock at launch.
rules.body: The sponsor can't change the rate, cap or schedule. The team can still upgrade the program.

chain.title: Every number is on-chain.
chain.body: Vesting is plain arithmetic anyone can check.
